item.title: Flock surveillance cameras face widespread vandalism
item.description: Across the U.S., people are damaging and removing Flock cameras, reflecting growing public opposition.

item.title: Federal authorities reduce wild horse numbers in Colorado
item.description: Officials say overpopulation is harming resources, but activists disagree with the approach.

item.title: USS Lincoln returns home; experts assess mental toll of long deployment
item.description: After nine months at sea, the USS Abraham Lincoln heads home. Specialists discuss the psychological effects of extended time aboard.

item.title: Trump's outreach to Kim raises price, Seoul fears marginalization
item.description: Analysts caution that Trump's transactional alliance approach could undermine political trust.
